This is a .NET Blazor WebAssembly project for an astronomy-themed app called AboveMe. The app will use the ipgeolocation API to determine the user's location and display astronomy data. The UI should feature a starry, twinkling background and a modern, beautiful design. Keep the following in mind:
- Ensure best engineering practices
- Keep naming conventions consistent and logical
- Use comments to explain complex logic
- Do not make assumptions of what is desired beyond what is specified and ask for clarification if needed
-Ensure security best practices are followed, especially when handling API keys and user data
- Focus on performance optimization, especially for loading and rendering the starry background and astronomy data
- Ensure the app is responsive and works well on various screen sizes and devices
- Use modern Blazor features and patterns
- Ensure accessibility standards are met for users with disabilities
- Write unit tests for critical components and services
- Use dependency injection for services
